Hi Samir —

Appreciate the diagram. Week of Oct 11 is feasible from our side. To be efficient I recommend we split the first week into two short touchpoints:
1) Kickoff (30m) — confirm contacts, scope, and cutover window.
2) Networking deep-dive (45-60m) with our infra engineer to validate CIDRs, routes, and DNS plan.

For Redwood to accept an initial handoff we will need the following from Windward before the networking deep-dive:
- VPC CIDR blocks & peering candidate subnets
- Expected concurrent throughput and max seq length for model traffic (helps sizing)
- List of IPs to allow for private endpoints or an outbound NAT plan if using egress
- Point-of-contact for on-prem install team (physical access, packaging expectations)

I've looped Marcus for the technical runbook and Grace for security/compliance items (she will run the SOC2 / audit checklist if needed). Marcus — can you share the most recent on-prem package and the connectivity checklist we use with customers?

Proposed kickoff: Oct 12 at 10:00 AM PST (30m). Proposed networking deep-dive: Oct 13 at 9:00 AM PST (60m). If those times don't work, suggest alternatives and we'll adapt.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Customer Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference

Samir / Stephanie —

Attaching the current artifacts we hand off for private/on-prem installs. High level notes:
- We support two connectivity patterns: VPC peering (preferred when both accounts are in same cloud provider) and PrivateLink-like private endpoints. If you want egress through NAT, we require a static egress IP or range for allowlisting.
- Recommended CIDR sizing: allocate /20 for Redwood peering subnets + /24 for endpoint ENIs per AZ. This avoids collisions when we provision NAT/ENIs.
- DNS: We create split-horizon records for model endpoints. If Windward prefers to own DNS, we publish the private DNS delegation steps in the runbook.
- On-prem appliance: our package is a containerized runtime + installer. We will ship redwood_onprem_package_v2.tar.gz for staging; it contains checksums, a bringup script, and a small local metrics collector.

Action items I can own ahead of the deep-dive:
- Upload S3 staging link for package and manifests (will share by EOD).
- Pre-populate the networking-checklist.xlsx with example values for your team to review.

Attachments referenced: redwood_onprem_package_v2.tar.gz (tgz), networking-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)
